objective: Prepare Season 2 reward SQL safely for disposable/staging tests: prevent the same verified Main event minting twice after a Season 2 rule version change; keep verified weekly foundation evidence valid across an in-season rule upgrade. Never activate rewards or touch Season1 production.
productionBaselineEvidence: Existing staging-only #963 consolidated source descendant of published Season2 staging source a1118ec69079dad757222a23798bde59b6a5b002. Season 1 main remains production; the SQL is in docs/season2/sql and not a migration. Existing disposable Postgres reward CI passed on #953 at a252a0fed48939eca935d1dee806ec1a83bc940f; this change requires fresh exact-head CI.
chosenApproach: Keep the unexposed private buklod_s2 draft and all existing disabled controls; enforce unique immutable source IDs independent of mutable audit rule_version, preserve historical weekly proof, and run real disposable PostgreSQL RLS/race/rollover regression scenarios in GitHub Actions.
selectionRationale: A rule_version in the uniqueness key allows the same verified post/quiz to be paid again after rules change. Enforcing one receipt per actual source is less risky than version-specific dedupe and does not alter any existing production schema.
preserveBehaviors: Season 1 BP/QMP/30% AdMob, cash, rank, withdrawals and referral logic stay unchanged in production and staging source.
Season 2 schema remains private, disabled, unexposed and source-only: no service keys in clients, no actual Supabase migration or reward activation.
A previously verified Season 2 receipt can satisfy weekly foundation after a rule_version change; it cannot ever mint again from the same source ID.
Preserve all successful existing disposable Postgres SQL concurrency, idempotent purchase, wallet ledger, RLS, Official exclusion and offline contracts.
acceptanceChecks: GitHub Engineering Accountability gate must pass on this exact PR head with exactly one changed scope manifest.
GitHub Season 2 Isolated SQL Contract workflow runs against local PostgreSQL 17 only when PR base is approved Season2 staging branch.
Behavior test verifies duplicate-source replay after rules revision returns DUPLICATE without modifying balance or receipt count.
Behavior test verifies legacy verified learning+community receipts still produce an eligible weekly foundation after a rule revision.
No production or Supabase project write, no EAS OTA, no native package change, and no user earnings claimed.
Actual independent staging Supabase project plus signed gating and Android testing is required before making live rewards available to testers.
Governance implementation ledger documents SQL-only evidence and stays PLANNED, never fraudulently marks live or RC verification.
alternativeApproaches: Leave duplicate source keys tied to rule_version and rely on the caller to never replay (rejected: replays unavoidable with offline retries and future rules).
Delete rule_version from historical receipts (rejected: destroys audit evidence).
Make verified event identity immutable while retaining an auditable rule_version field (chosen).
